message.content: It depends on what you’re looking for—genre, critical acclaim, or audience reception—but many critics and audiences agree that **“Parasite”** (2019) was still dominating discussions into 2020, especially after its Oscar win. If you’re looking for something released in 2020 itself, **“Tenet”** (2020) was a high‑profile release that sparked a lot of conversation, though it received mixed reviews. For a more universally praised film from 2020, **“Soul”** (2020) from Pixar won the Academy Award for Best Animated Feature and was widely celebrated for its storytelling and music.
